LESSON: CLASSES OF FIRE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Mixtures, Elements and Compounds
Topic 1.3: Classes of fire

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Classes of fire. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: where they can be seen. What are the dangers of fire in nature?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify causes of fire in nature
2. explain the role of the components of fire triangle in the spread of fire
3. describe ways of controlling different classes of fires
